question:
The sentence has been divided into three parts, identify the error segment in the sentence given below. Choose no error if there is no error in the sentence.

After a long day at work, he decided to switch of his/ phone, disconnecting from the digital world/ to immerse himself in a good book.

options.text: to immerse himself in a good book.
phone, disconnecting from the digital world
After a long day at work, he decided to switch of his

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. "After a long day at work, he decided to switch of his".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"switch of"** is incorrect and should be replaced with **"switch off"**.
 
• **Switch off** means to turn off a device or machine. (बंद करना)
 
 
• **Example:** He decided to switch off his phone before going to bed.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct word should be **"switch off"** instead of **"switch of"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**
